plot_transcripts: plot multiple gene transcripts with CDS, UTR, and intron annotations on a matplotlib axis
draw_transcript: draw a single transcript with colored CDS, UTR regions, and strand direction arrows on an axis
draw_strand_arrows: draw chevron arrows on intron lines to indicate transcript strand direction and orientation
draw_interval: draw a rectangle patch on a matplotlib axis representing a genomic interval with optional label
TranscriptStylePreset: create a TranscriptStylePreset enum with STANDARD or MINIMAL styling for transcript visualization plots
